subject: OnyxHealth onboarding orchestration & owners (sales → CS)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@onyxhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@onyxhealth.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: OnyxHealth onboarding orchestration & owners (sales → CS)

Hi team — handing over OnyxHealth for implementation. Quick summary and asks below.

Deal snapshot
- Account: OnyxHealth (payer-facing digital ops)
- ARR: $420k first-year commitment; committed to Dedicated tier with burst capacity
- Signed: SOW v3 signed (DocuSign link below), start-of-service target: 2027-06-07
- Primary contact: Elena Torres (Head, Digital Ops) — elena.torres@onyxhealth.com

Business goals (from execs)
1) Replace legacy routing for clinical triage with Redwood-powered chat flow (real-time generation latency SLA ≤ 220ms p50)
2) Deploy embeddings-based search for triage transcripts (initial 10m docs)
3) Privacy: PHI allowed inside redwood running in customer-designated VPC; Onyx requires monthly audit log exports and 12-month retention

Technical notes (from sales engineering)
- Expected steady-state token volume: 30M tokens / month; burst to 80M for peak clinic hours
- Integration: client will POST events to our hosted API via VPC peering; they prefer mutual TLS and have a corporate proxy
- Network checklist attached: onyx-network-requirements.xlsx

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation
- Confirm primary implementation lead and secondary escalation owner
- Confirm resource plan for a 4-week sprint (SOW covers 4 sprint milestones)
- Call out any compliance evidence we must surface for procurement (SOC2 artifacts, audit log exports)

Attachments: OnyxHealth_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW signed), onyx-network-requirements.xlsx (SE notes), redwood-onboarding-checklist.csv
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ONYX-SOW-v3
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ONX-2027-0032

Timestamps: kickoff target week of 2027-06-07; they prefer a kickoff call between 2027-06-06 and 2027-06-08.

Elena — thanks again for the partnership. Karthik / Tessa / Connor — please reply with owner assignments and any immediate blockers by EOD today so I can lock the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0219

--
OnyxHealth SOW (attached), network checklist (attached)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@onyxhealth.com>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: OnyxHealth onboarding orchestration & owners (sales → CS)

Thanks Marissa — congrats on the close. Short list from my side so we can scope the first sprint correctly: 

1) Data residency / PHI: Elena, can you confirm the VPC region (us-east-1 or us-west-2)? Onyx’s KMS policy we saw in procurement looks standard but need region to validate replication windows and audit export cadence.
2) Token volume validation: the 30M steady / 80M burst helps. Can you share a sample daily distribution or peak hour estimate (max rps)? That affects batching config and node allocation.
3) Integration method: Marissa noted mutual TLS + proxy — Connor, can you confirm whether we need a NAT or direct peering for the hosted API? Put a note in the network sheet if you need us to run a connectivity test.

Operational asks we will own:
- Weekly status cadence: Wed 30-mins for first 6 weeks (propose Wed 10am PT)
- Acceptance criteria: 1) latency SLA validated on synthetic workload, 2) embeddings search accuracy on dev corpus, 3) audit exports reach Onyx retention pipeline

I’ll start a checklist in the Drive folder and assign action owners when Tessa confirms primary leads.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
